product_one_liner.value: Lob helps marketing, product, and operations teams automate the creation, printing, sending, tracking, and measurement of personalized direct-mail campaigns at scale.
product_one_liner.notes: Lob describes an end-to-end direct-mail platform and print network for marketing, product, and operations teams, covering personalized campaigns and measurement. Sources: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/11/12/3186623/0/en/Lob-Strengthens-Executive-Leadership-Team-with-Appointments-of-CFO-CPO-and-CRO.html ; https://www.lob.com/blog/should-i-use-chatgpt-to-write-direct-mail-marketing-copy

pricing_page.notes: Lob has a public pricing page showing a plan starting at $0 per month. Source: https://www.lob.com/pricing

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Lob's customer page explicitly identifies 120Water and Included Health as users of its direct-mail services. Source: https://lob.com/customers | named_customers.0: The customer page describes 120Water's results using Lob. | named_customers.1: The customer page explicitly describes Included Health using automated direct mail.

employee_band.notes: Lob's LinkedIn company profile lists company size as 201–500 employees. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/3231576

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profiles identify San Francisco as Lob's base and headquarters. Sources: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/lob ; https://tracxn.com/d/companies/lob/__xJBMw-qXYC7ZeZ_oyZH99ovllMrbsaaGi8xEZpKub3g | hq_country: The company profile identifies Lob's headquarters as San Francisco, United States. Source: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/lob/__xJBMw-qXYC7ZeZ_oyZH99ovllMrbsaaGi8xEZpKub3g

founded_year.notes: Lob's company profile explicitly states that it was founded in 2013. Source: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/lob

eng_blog.notes: The engineering index includes implementation posts about SDK generation and infrastructure. A staff-engineer account explains Elasticsearch, S3, and Elixir implementation, while a solutions-engineer article explains Lob's ML models. Sources: http://lob.com/category/engineering ; http://lob.com/blog/elixir-streams-elasticsearch-aws-s3 ; https://lob.com/blog/how-lobs-machine-learning-models-aim-to-cut-cost-and-waste-in-direct-mail

public_docs.notes: Lob provides extensive public API documentation covering postcards, campaigns, URL shortening, and other product functionality. Source: https://docs.lob.com/

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The public job-board feed lists five openings: Business Operations Manager, Corporate Counsel, Enterprise Account Executive, Partner Operations Manager, and Senior Manager, USPS Programs. None has a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title. Source: https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/lob/jobs

model_provider.value: scikit-learn random forest regression; Lob also describes its own Postage Class Optimization and Return-to-Sender Prediction models as being tested.
model_provider.notes: Lob explicitly describes using scikit-learn random forest regression and names two internally developed prediction models. The latter are described as being tested, not confirmed as generally deployed. No external LLM provider was established from the documentation, security pages, blog, or subprocessors reviewed. Sources: http://lob.com/blog/experimenting-with-machine-learning ; https://lob.com/blog/how-lobs-machine-learning-models-aim-to-cut-cost-and-waste-in-direct-mail

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Lob claims completed SOC 2 Type 2 and HIPAA audits and names GDPR in its regulatory-alignment statement. GDPR is a compliance claim, not a separately verified certification. Neither ISO 27001 nor PCI DSS was established. Source: https://trust.lob.com/ | compliance_certs.0: Lob explicitly claims SOC 2 Type 2 compliance and annual auditing. | compliance_certs.1: Lob states that its annual HIPAA audit has been completed. | compliance_certs.2: The trust center names GDPR and describes regulatory alignment; this is not evidence of a separately issued GDPR certification.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: PitchBook lists Debt - General as the latest completed financing. This is later in its financing history than the dated February 2021 Series C; the debt date and amount are not displayed. Source: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/58146-22 | funding_date: The latest listed completed debt financing has no publicly displayed date. February 2021 belongs to the earlier Series C, not the debt transaction. Source: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/58146-22 | funding_amount_usd: The latest listed completed financing is Debt - General, but its amount is not publicly displayed. The older $50 million Series C amount cannot safely be assigned to this later debt transaction. Source: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/58146-22

raised_18mo.notes: The confirmed dated Series C is outside the eighteen-month window, but a later completed debt transaction is undated. Its timing cannot be established, so neither true nor false is sufficiently supported. Sources: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/58146-22 ; https://www.lob.com/news/lob-raises-50-million-in-series-c-funding-to-scale-its-direct-mail-platform

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Lob's current job board includes an Enterprise Account Executive opening. Sources: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/embed/job_board?for=lob ; http://www.lob.com/careers/apply?gh_jid=8082143

launched_6mo.notes: Lob introduced its No-Code Design Suite on August 31, 2026, inside the six-month window. The announcement describes visual editing, dynamic field mapping, and production-ready templates, constituting a substantial feature launch. Source: https://www.lob.com/blog/introducing-lobs-no-code-design-suite

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On November 12, 2025, within the twelve-month window, Lob announced executive appointments including David Pickel as CFO, Raji Bedi as CPO, and Paul Rosen as CRO. Source: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/11/12/3186623/0/en/Lob-Strengthens-Executive-Leadership-Team-with-Appointments-of-CFO-CPO-and-CRO.html

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Lob's subprocessor documentation lists Salesforce for customer management/support, Marketo and Mutiny for sales-lead management, and Mailchimp for email marketing. This establishes visible use, rather than merely available integrations. Source: https://www.lob.com/subprocessors | crm_stack_signal.0: Lob lists Salesforce as a customer-management or support subprocessor. | crm_stack_signal.1: Lob lists Marketo for customer sales-lead management. | crm_stack_signal.2: Lob lists Mailchimp as its email-marketing provider. | crm_stack_signal.3: Lob lists Mutiny for customer sales-lead management.
